description: Petal Cobra default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/petal_cobra-character-sheet.png (intake.json swatch chips 215,219,202 / 127,146,121 / 76,95,86 / 225,205,170 / 245,212,154 / 41,51,47 + direct medians of the drawn surfaces, sample px cited per region). A pale-sage upright serpent with narrow almond amber eyes, a thin ink smile, three pairs of oval amber torso markings and two large cupped hood petals: inner face green shading from light at the bottom to dark under the curl (five bands), darker vein strokes, a lighter-green back face, and a cream rim rolling over at the top tip. The ink outline 41,51,47 is drawing style and is not a region (only the smile stroke uses it). No glow (the sheet draws none): every region writes zero Glow.

body.note: pale-sage body: chip 215,219,202; drawn medians front head (250,300) 214,218,201 / front tail (250,560) 213,217,200 / side tail (1050,600) 214,218,200

mouth.note: the gentle smile is an ink stroke (front (243-262, 393-396), face panel): the ink chip 41,51,47 (intake: inferred by spacing)

petal_vein.note: vein strokes on the inner face: the sheet draws them DARKER than the surface (local-median line detector, front R (350-455, 280-480) 87,107,94 vs surround 101,122,105; hood panel 79,98,88)

petal_back_shade.note: petal back face lowest band (row z < 3.0): drawn back view (585,500-520) 105-110,126-132,107-110

petal_back_vein.note: vein strokes on the back face: drawn back view R (720-850, 300-480) dark-line median 117,136,114 vs surround 128,148,121

petal_rim.note: cream rim + rolled top curl: chip 225,205,170 (drawn rim lit median 225,221,200, crease 210,195,164; the chip is the artist's declared rim tone)
